Package io.micronaut.dev

@NullMarked package io.micronaut.dev
The development mode launcher: MicronautDevMain starts an application behind a reloadable class loader and the DevRuntime recompiles, restarts and reports as sources and resources change.
Since:
5.3.0
Author:
graemerocher
  • Related Packages
    Package
    Description
    io.micronaut.dev.agent
    The Java agent that hands development mode the Instrumentation it redefines classes with.
    io.micronaut.dev.change
    Detection of what changed between two generations of the compiled output.
    io.micronaut.dev.compile
    The compiler contract, with embedded implementations, that turns changed sources into a new generation.
    io.micronaut.dev.http
    What development mode adds to an HTTP server: requests wait for a reload in progress, and a failed compilation is shown instead of the stale application.
    io.micronaut.dev.livereload
    The LiveReload contract: browsers connected to the server reload the page, or swap a stylesheet, when the application restarted or a static file or template changed.
    io.micronaut.dev.loader
    The classloaders of the reloadable tier: one per generation behind a stable facade.
    io.micronaut.dev.management
    The /dev management endpoint: the state of development mode, and a reload on request.
    io.micronaut.dev.manifest
    The manifest a build tool writes to describe the project to the launcher.
    io.micronaut.dev.tck
    The reload TCK: a harness that runs a small project through two real generations of the development runtime, and assertions a module makes over them.
    io.micronaut.dev.test
    Running tests in development mode: the runner contract, with a JUnit Platform runner built in, the events a run streams, and the JUnit XML reports written from them.
  • Class
    Description
    CompileFailure
    A compilation that failed: the running generation stays as it was and the diagnostics are shown until the next successful compilation.
    DevApplicationContextConfigurer
    Configures every application context an application builds while a DevRuntime runs the process: the reloadable class loader, the dev environment, the retained beans of the previous generation, the runtime itself as a bean, and a FileWatcher backed by the runtime's one watcher.
    DevRuntime
    The engine of development mode: watches the sources and resources the manifest names, compiles what changed, and restarts the application on a new generation of the reloadable class loader, keeping the singletons a BeanRetentionPolicy retains.
    MicronautDevMain
    The entry point of development mode: java -cp @runtime.argfile io.micronaut.dev.MicronautDevMain --manifest build/micronaut-dev/dev.properties.
    TestRequest
    A run of the tests asked for by a person or a tool rather than by a change, in test mode.
